DML.SELECT: SELECT node_id as "id", alias as "alias", description as "description", scenario_id as "scenarioId", management_area_id as "managementAreaId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.cctv_scenario_nodes WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.cctv_scenario_nodes (node_id, alias, description, scenario_id, management_area_id, enabled, visible) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.cctv_scenario_nodes'$'node_id'} , :alias , :description , :scenarioId , :managementAreaId , :enabled , :visible)
